basis: Focused source review following all-map scan; retains cosmetic, inaccessible and represented railing gaps under the visibility model.

verdicts.conclusion: No change is supported for the twenty flagged opening families: eighteen are exterior boundaries, source seams, or already reviewed structures; two are represented ramp railings. This classification does not certify every height elsewhere on these parents.
limits: The earlier unequal-elevation and constant-height rays are retained only as investigation history. Rays offset from the authored front skin do not establish a cap elevation.
The correction uses the continuous front facade and its explicit top-skin faces recorded in icebox-elevation-edge-front-topology.json. Frozen/clipped section maxima are not cap oracles.
Caps are absolute native elevations because the affected wall rows use floorElevationMeters=0.0. Integration must mirror the change through the existing side-alignment path.
No cap is inferred where a parent endpoint lies outside the recorded source top-skin X range; those endpoint pieces require another source owner.

The initial two ramp-cap proposals were rejected after inspecting complete rail assemblies. No Icebox wall asset was changed. Finite far-side sampling cannot certify all geometry elsewhere on a parent.

families.evidence: The associated object is a ramp and every candidate uses sourceRole=ground. The 18 samples trace one horizontal boundary at y=270.221. A vertical gap between ramp facets cannot define a sight opening through that boundary. This invalidates the detector evidence but does not prove the current wall correct.
